description: Builds every bounded data-cube view from its minimum-cardinality immediate parent and checksums ordered groups and parent choices.

source.title: Arithmetic Data Cube as a Data Intensive Benchmark
source.related_work: Harinarayan, Rajaraman, and Ullman, Implementing Data Cubes Efficiently, SIGMOD 1996
source.algorithm_attribution: Smallest-parent view lattice construction for the arithmetic data cube; bounded clean-room scalar profile

contract.views: Every mask from 0 through (1 << dimension_count) - 1, inclusive
contract.view_construction: Build the full view directly. Visit lower masks in descending popcount order; select an immediate superset with the fewest groups, tie-breaking on lowest added dimension; project its groups and merge measures.
contract.aggregation: Equal projected keys merge; measures are summed; groups are ordered lexicographically by selected attribute values in ascending dimension order.
contract.checksum: For each mask in ascending order add (mask+1)*1000000 + (parent_mask+2)*10000 + group_count*1000; full-view parent_mask is -1. For each sorted group at zero-based index g add (g+1)*(measure_sum+1), then add (g+1)*(dimension+1)*(key+1) for each selected dimension.
contract.distinction: Unlike npb_serial_dc, which directly groups raw rows independently for each nonempty mask, this profile constructs lower views through smallest immediate parents and includes the empty view.

input.encoding: dimension count, row count, then each row's attributes and measure

output.meaning: checksum of all ordered view aggregates and selected smallest-parent masks
